description: This file is a Java class named RecurringDepositAccountStatusChecker, providing utility methods to verify the status of recurring deposit accounts in integration tests. It contains methods for asserting various account states such as approved, pending, active, rejected, withdrawn, closed, and special conditions like premature closed or matured. It also includes methods to fetch the account status from the server.

classes.name: RecurringDepositAccountStatusChecker
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for verifying and retrieving recurring deposit account statuses in integration tests.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositIsApproved
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit status is approved.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositIsPending
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit status is pending approval.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositIsActive
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit is active.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositIsRejected
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit has been rejected.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositIsWithdrawn
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit has been withdrawn by the applicant.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositAccountIsClosed
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit account is closed.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositAccountIsNotActive
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit account is not active.

methods.name: getStatusOfRecurringDepositAccount
methods.description: Fetches the status of a specific recurring deposit account from the server.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositAccountIsPrematureClosed
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit is prematurely closed.

methods.name: verifyRecurringDepositAccountIsMatured
methods.description: Checks that the recurring deposit is matured.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: A private helper method returning the boolean status of a given recurring deposit status key.
